questions.definition: A person who is **overwhelmed** is completely filled with too much emotion or work.
options: someone who is unable to cope due to stress or volume
questions.answer: someone who is unable to cope due to stress or volume

questions.definition: The **suburb** is a residential area that is just outside a city or town.
options: a small village near a town
a neighbourhood on the outskirts of a town or city
questions.answer: a neighbourhood on the outskirts of a town or city

questions.definition: If something is **irrevocable**, it cannot be changed or reversed.
options: something that can be easily forgotten
something that is final and cannot be undone
questions.answer: something that is final and cannot be undone

questions.definition: To **commute** means to regularly travel to and from work or school.
options: to stay at home all day
to walk or drive a short distance daily
to travel long distances by air or sea
questions.answer: to walk or drive a short distance daily

questions.definition: The **artisan** is a skilled craftsman who makes products by hand, such as pottery or textiles.
options: a designer who works in a large factory
a person who creates traditional handmade goods
a machine operator in an industrial setting
questions.answer: a person who creates traditional handmade goods
